newsitem.title: UK: Palm oil finishes off day's highs in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Palm oil finishes off day's highs in Europe.

text.p: Palm oil prices eased towards the close of the European vegetable oil market on Monday in thin trading.
Earlier a late surge in prices in Asia had supported prices but a lack of buying interest here forced sellers to retreat.
In the soft oil sector higher Chicago futures had little impact on soy oil prices, but rape oil made further gains during the afternoon.
Coconut oil sellers reduced their prices in an attempt to attract buyers.
Palm oil closed with crude and refined oils $2.50 to $5 up and no futher was business reported during the afternoon.
Dutch soy oil closed one guilder up while rape oil was 0.50 guilders higher to unchanged in tradeless markets.
Based on sellers' prices rape oil was offered at a premium of two to three guilders over soyoil at the close against three to four guilders on Friday.
Coconut oil closed $5 down to $5 up after Dec/Jan traded at $767.50 and Jan/Feb at $755 a tonne cif.
Traders said most of the business was switching.
Palmkernel oil finished $5 up to unchanged in a tradeless market.
